recomputation_note: Every rate below is recomputed from the individual promoted contracts (criterion values re-aggregated, router state re-derived via classify_state/route against the hash-pinned catalog) and cross-checked against the summary blocks run_cohort wrote into the artifact. Local lookups only; zero paid calls.

abstention.note: The promoted path reads the balanced 526-d criterion heads by ARGMAX with no abstention gating: every criterion is determinate, so score_min == score_max and every case is decidable -- undecidable and abstention rates are 0.0 BY CONSTRUCTION, not by measurement. The criterion_abstention_v1 cutoffs were fit on the pre-promotion 512-d dermlip head and would mis-abstain on these heads; per-criterion top-minus-second margins are plumbed into each contract (criterion_margins) so a future abstention policy can be re-fit for the promoted heads.

router.conflict_state_vs_contract_conflict_note: Router CONFLICT (55) exceeds contract-level conflicts (54) by 1: classifier confidence below 0.40 is routed as an unresolved differential even when the checklist agrees.
router.call_vs_case_note: CONFLICT cases can request guidance for both candidate conditions, so gated CALLS can exceed retrieving CASES; both denominators are reported. The saving is hypothetical: binding is a free local lookup that ran for every case here.

guideline_citation.note: Citation rate is bounded by corpus coverage, not by retrieval quality. Naevi, seborrhoeic keratoses and the miscellaneous group have no formal guideline; the system reports that rather than generating management text.
